title: ctenitis setosa
intro: Ctenitis setosa, commonly known as the Setose Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various ailments, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis setosa include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
